body:
## Pull request overview

This PR removes obsolete tests for `timeline` and `chatbot` components that were previously extracted from the core `@object-ui/components` package into dedicated plugin packages (`@object-ui/plugin-timeline` and `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`). The tests were failing because they expected these components to be registered in the core component registry, but the components are now only registered when their respective plugin packages are imported.

**Changes:**
- Removed 1 timeline registration test from the new components test suite
- Removed 6 renderer tests (3 for timeline, 3 for chatbot) from the complex disclosure renderers test suite
- All other tests remain intact and the test files are syntactically correct

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/components/src/new-components.test.ts` | Removed the "Complex Components" describe block containing the timeline component registration test |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/complex-disclosure-renderers.test.tsx` | Removed "Timeline Renderer" and "Chatbot Renderer" describe blocks containing 6 tests total that validated component registration and rendering |
